name: discord-pro
tagline: The community server, run by the product
description: A dedicated daemon that runs the Quox Discord community server: build and GitHub feeds posted straight into channels, AutoMod covering the baseline moderation load, and grounded support answers drawn from the same corpus Quox uses everywhere else. Replies that go beyond a grounded answer are governed and approval-gated, never sent unsupervised.
shortDescription: Server management, build and GitHub feeds, AutoMod baseline, and governed grounded support in your Discord server
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Runs your Discord server as a real daemon, not a webhook glued to a workflow
Build and GitHub feeds posted into channels the moment they happen
AutoMod baseline handles the routine moderation load automatically
Grounded support answers cite the same corpus Quox uses everywhere else, never invented
Replies beyond a grounded answer are governed and approval-gated, human decides
